# Phillips Handyman & Home Services

> Local handyman based in Wallkill, NY, serving Ulster and Orange County in the Hudson Valley, anywhere within a 45 minute drive of Wallkill. Owner Kenny Phillips does the work himself. Free written estimates, replies to quote requests within 48 hours.

## Service area
Anywhere within a 45 minute drive of Wallkill, NY, in Ulster and Orange County.
- Ulster County: Wallkill, Shawangunk, Gardiner, New Paltz, Plattekill, Marlboro, Highland, Lloyd, Rosendale, Stone Ridge, Marbletown, Accord, Kerhonkson, Ellenville, Esopus, Port Ewen, Kingston, High Falls
- Orange County: Walden, Montgomery, Maybrook, Pine Bush, Newburgh, New Windsor, Cornwall, Washingtonville, Middletown, Goshen, Chester, Monroe

## Services
- Outdoor: new wood fences, fence repair, gates, landscaping, deck refinishing (clean, sand, stain, seal), cedar shake roof replacement (full tear off and new roof) and refinishing, gazebos, pressure washing for siding, driveways, patios, decks and fences, barn quilts
- Repairs & mounting: TV mounting, hanging shelves, Vitsœ 606 shelving installation and reconfiguration, hanging mirrors and art, drywall patching and repair, small repair lists
- Carpentry & custom builds: closet built-ins and custom storage, Montessori kids' shelves, baseboard and trim, window replacement, interior and exterior doors, custom furniture (workbenches, shop carts, step stools, lamps)
- Interiors & renovations: interior painting (walls, ceilings, trim), cabinet painting, microcement floors, engineered hardwood flooring, room refreshes, shed to finished room conversions, walk-in coolers (framing, insulation, drywall, trim)
- Not offered: electrical and plumbing (referred to licensed trades), deck building

## Details
- Free written estimates. Jobs over $500 need a deposit to schedule.
- Payment: card, check, cash, Venmo or Zelle.
- The website has an instant rough price estimator for each of the four service groups. Flooring, renovations, custom furniture and roof replacement are quoted from photos.
- Contact: kenny@handymanphillips.com, or text/call (number on the website). Quote form at https://handymanphillips.com/#contact
